item.text: The server currently owns a global `sync.Once` exporter cache. That can reuse an exporter across different configurations and makes the exporter tests depend on resetting global state. I’ll move construction into `internal/tracing` and make each call use its own configuration.

cat > internal/tracing/tracing_test.go <<'EOF'
package tracing

import (
	\"context\"
	\"strings\"
	\"testing\"

	\"github.com/stretchr/testify/assert\"
	\"github.com/stretchr/testify/require\"
	\"go.flipt.io/flipt/internal/config\"
	\"go.opentelemetry.io/otel/attribute\"
	semconv \"go.opentelemetry.io/otel/semconv/v1.4.0\"
)

func TestNewResource(t *testing.T) {
	t.Setenv(\"OTEL_SERVICE_NAME\", \"\")
	t.Setenv(\"OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES\", \"\")
	res, err := newResource(context.Background(), \"1.2.3\")
	require.NoError(t, err)
	attrs := res.Set()
	assert.Equal(t, \"flipt\", attrs.Value(semconv.ServiceNameKey).AsString())
	assert.Equal(t, \"1.2.3\", attrs.Value(semconv.ServiceVersionKey).AsString())

	t.Setenv(\"OTEL_SERVICE_NAME\", \"from-service-name\")
	t.Setenv(\"OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES\", \"service.name=from-resource,region=test\")
	res, err = newResource(context.Background(), \"4.5.6\")
	require.NoError(t, err)
	attrs = res.Set()
	assert.Equal(t, \"from-service-name\", attrs.Value(semconv.ServiceNameKey).AsString())
	assert.Equal(t, \"4.5.6\", attrs.Value(semconv.ServiceVersionKey).AsString())
	assert.Equal(t, \"test\", attrs.Value(attribute.Key(\"region\")).AsString())
}

func TestNewProvider(t *testing.T) {
	provider, err := NewProvider(context.Background(), \"1.2.3\")
	require.NoError(t, err)
	t.Cleanup(func() { require.NoError(t, provider.Shutdown(context.Background())) })
	assert.Equal(t, \"AlwaysOnSampler\", provider.Sampler().Description())
}

func TestGetExporter(t *testing.T) {
	tests := []struct {
		name string
		cfg  config.TracingConfig
	}{
		{\"Jaeger\", config.TracingConfig{Exporter: config.TracingJaeger, Jaeger: config.JaegerTracingConfig{Host: \"localhost\", Port: 6831}}},
		{\"Zipkin\", config.TracingConfig{Exporter: config.TracingZipkin, Zipkin: config.ZipkinTracingConfig{Endpoint: \"http://localhost:9411/api/v2/spans\"}}},
		{\"OTLP HTTP\", config.TracingConfig{Exporter: config.TracingOTLP, OTLP: config.OTLPTracingConfig{Endpoint: \"http://localhost:4318\", Headers: map[string]string{\"key\": \"value\"}}}},
		{\"OTLP HTTPS\", config.TracingConfig{Exporter: config.TracingOTLP, OTLP: config.OTLPTracingConfig{Endpoint: \"https://localhost:4318\", Headers: map[string]string{\"key\": \"value\"}}}},
		{\"OTLP GRPC\", config.TracingConfig{Exporter: config.TracingOTLP, OTLP: config.OTLPTracingConfig{Endpoint: \"grpc://localhost:4317\", Headers: map[string]string{\"key\": \"value\"}}}},
		{\"OTLP default\", config.TracingConfig{Exporter: config.TracingOTLP, OTLP: config.OTLPTracingConfig{Endpoint: \"localhost:4317\", Headers: map[string]string{\"key\": \"value\"}}}},
	}
	for _, tt := range tests {
		t.Run(tt.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			exp, shutdown, err := GetExporter(context.Background(), &tt.cfg)
			require.NoError(t, err)
			require.NotNil(t, exp)
			require.NotNil(t, shutdown)
			t.Cleanup(func() { require.NoError(t, shutdown(context.Background())) })
		})
	}
}

func TestGetExporterIndependentCalls(t *testing.T) {
	bad := &config.TracingConfig{Exporter: config.TracingExporter(99)}
	_, _, err := GetExporter(context.Background(), bad)
	require.Error(t, err)
	assert.True(t, strings.HasPrefix(err.Error(), \"unsupported tracing exporter: 99\"))

	good := &config.TracingConfig{Exporter: config.TracingZipkin, Zipkin: config.ZipkinTracingConfig{Endpoint: \"http://localhost:9411/api/v2/spans\"}}
	first, firstShutdown, err := GetExporter(context.Background(), good)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	second, secondShutdown, err := GetExporter(context.Background(), good)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	assert.NotSame(t, first, second)
	require.NoError(t, firstShutdown(context.Background()))
	require.NoError(t, secondShutdown(context.Background()))
}

func TestGetExporterInvalidEndpoint(t *testing.T) {
	for _, endpoint := range []string{\"http://%\", \"localhost\", \"ftp://localhost:4317\", \"grpc://localhost:4317/path\"} {
		t.Run(endpoint, func(t *testing.T) {
			cfg := &config.TracingConfig{Exporter: config.TracingOTLP, OTLP: config.OTLPTracingConfig{Endpoint: endpoint}}
			_, _, err := GetExporter(context.Background(), cfg)
			require.Error(t, err)
			assert.Contains(t, err.Error(), \"parsing otlp endpoint:\")
		})
	}
}
EOF

item.text: The resource test confirms that `OTEL_SERVICE_NAME` overrides the default service name while the supplied version remains present. The gRPC server now gets its provider and exporter through `internal/tracing`; the package tests are still compiling the repository’s dependencies.

item.command:
/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('internal/cmd/grpc_test.go')
s=p.read_text()
s=s[:s.index('func TestGetTraceExporter')] + s[s.index('func TestNewGRPCServer'):]
s=s.replace('\\t\"errors\"\\n','').replace('\\t\"sync\"\\n','')
p.write_text(s)
PY
cat > internal/tracing/tracing_test.go <<'EOF'
package tracing

import (
	\"context\"
	\"strings\"
	\"testing\"

	\"github.com/stretchr/testify/assert\"
	\"github.com/stretchr/testify/require\"
	\"go.flipt.io/flipt/internal/config\"
	\"go.opentelemetry.io/otel/attribute\"
	semconv \"go.opentelemetry.io/otel/semconv/v1.4.0\"
)

func TestNewResource(t *testing.T) {
	t.Setenv(\"OTEL_SERVICE_NAME\", \"\")
	t.Setenv(\"OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES\", \"\")
	res, err := newResource(context.Background(), \"1.2.3\")
	require.NoError(t, err)
	attrs := res.Set()
	assert.Equal(t, \"flipt\", attrs.Value(semconv.ServiceNameKey).AsString())
	assert.Equal(t, \"1.2.3\", attrs.Value(semconv.ServiceVersionKey).AsString())

	t.Setenv(\"OTEL_SERVICE_NAME\", \"from-service-name\")
	t.Setenv(\"OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES\", \"service.name=from-resource,region=test\")
	res, err = newResource(context.Background(), \"4.5.6\")
	require.NoError(t, err)
	attrs = res.Set()
	assert.Equal(t, \"from-service-name\", attrs.Value(semconv.ServiceNameKey).AsString())
	assert.Equal(t, \"4.5.6\", attrs.Value(semconv.ServiceVersionKey).AsString())
	assert.Equal(t, \"test\", attrs.Value(attribute.Key(\"region\")).AsString())
}

func TestNewProvider(t *testing.T) {
	provider, err := NewProvider(context.Background(), \"1.2.3\")
	require.NoError(t, err)
	t.Cleanup(func() { require.NoError(t, provider.Shutdown(context.Background())) })
	assert.Equal(t, \"AlwaysOnSampler\", provider.Sampler().Description())
}

func TestGetExporter(t *testing.T) {
	tests := []struct {
		name string
		cfg  config.TracingConfig
	}{
		{\"Jaeger\", config.TracingConfig{Exporter: config.TracingJaeger, Jaeger: config.JaegerTracingConfig{Host: \"localhost\", Port: 6831}}},
		{\"Zipkin\", config.TracingConfig{Exporter: config.TracingZipkin, Zipkin: config.ZipkinTracingConfig{Endpoint: \"http://localhost:9411/api/v2/spans\"}}},
		{\"OTLP HTTP\", config.TracingConfig{Exporter: config.TracingOTLP, OTLP: config.OTLPTracingConfig{Endpoint: \"http://localhost:4318\", Headers: map[string]string{\"key\": \"value\"}}}},
		{\"OTLP HTTPS\", config.TracingConfig{Exporter: config.TracingOTLP, OTLP: config.OTLPTracingConfig{Endpoint: \"https://localhost:4318\", Headers: map[string]string{\"key\": \"value\"}}}},
		{\"OTLP GRPC\", config.TracingConfig{Exporter: config.TracingOTLP, OTLP: config.OTLPTracingConfig{Endpoint: \"grpc://localhost:4317\", Headers: map[string]string{\"key\": \"value\"}}}},
		{\"OTLP default\", config.TracingConfig{Exporter: config.TracingOTLP, OTLP: config.OTLPTracingConfig{Endpoint: \"localhost:4317\", Headers: map[string]string{\"key\": \"value\"}}}},
	}
	for _, tt := range tests {
		t.Run(tt.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			exp, shutdown, err := GetExporter(context.Background(), &tt.cfg)
			require.NoError(t, err)
			require.NotNil(t, exp)
			require.NotNil(t, shutdown)
			t.Cleanup(func() { require.NoError(t, shutdown(context.Background())) })
		})
	}
}

func TestGetExporterIndependentCalls(t *testing.T) {
	bad := &config.TracingConfig{Exporter: config.TracingExporter(99)}
	_, _, err := GetExporter(context.Background(), bad)
	require.Error(t, err)
	assert.True(t, strings.HasPrefix(err.Error(), \"unsupported tracing exporter: 99\"))

	good := &config.TracingConfig{Exporter: config.TracingZipkin, Zipkin: config.ZipkinTracingConfig{Endpoint: \"http://localhost:9411/api/v2/spans\"}}
	first, firstShutdown, err := GetExporter(context.Background(), good)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	second, secondShutdown, err := GetExporter(context.Background(), good)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	assert.NotSame(t, first, second)
	require.NoError(t, firstShutdown(context.Background()))
	require.NoError(t, secondShutdown(context.Background()))
}

func TestGetExporterInvalidEndpoint(t *testing.T) {
	for _, endpoint := range []string{\"http://%\", \"localhost\", \"ftp://localhost:4317\", \"grpc://localhost:4317/path\"} {
		t.Run(endpoint, func(t *testing.T) {
			cfg := &config.TracingConfig{Exporter: config.TracingOTLP, OTLP: config.OTLPTracingConfig{Endpoint: endpoint}}
			_, _, err := GetExporter(context.Background(), cfg)
			require.Error(t, err)
			assert.Contains(t, err.Error(), \"parsing otlp endpoint:\")
		})
	}
}
